summary:
Strategic implementation plan to convert ravenadversary.com into a high-converting institutional destination:
1. Replaces legacy $10,000 / $25,000 pricing with $2,499 Single-Transaction Forensic Dossier (60-minute turnaround) and $7,500/month Institutional Desk Retainer across all pages and Corvus bot.
2. Integrates an Above-the-Fold Live Deal Showcase featuring 4 live October 2026 Raven Engine transactions (The Baldwin Group BWIN, Option Care Health OPCH, Integer Holdings ITGR, Penske Automotive PAG) with interactive PDF clause-card viewers and instant sample downloads.
3. Adds a dedicated buyer section specifically targeting M&A Shareholder Fiduciary Litigators and Appraisal Arbitrage (DGCL § 262) desks with verified attack vectors (MFW dual-cleansing defects, TRA windfalls, Revlon blind-auction truncations, several liability gaps).
4. Adds a frictionless direct intake bar in the hero section for instant warm-lead capture.
